description: This file is a Scala source code example demonstrating the use of ALS (Alternating Least Squares) for recommendation systems within Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes data parsing, model training, evaluation, and generating recommendations.

classes.name: ALSExample
classes.description: Main object demonstrating ALS recommendation workflow including data parsing, model training, evaluation, and generating recommendations.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Case class representing a user rating for a movie with userId, movieId, rating, and timestamp.

methods.name: parseRating
methods.description: Parses a string into a Rating object, splitting by '::' and converting fields to appropriate types.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method executing the ALS recommendation example: initializes Spark, loads data, trains model, evaluates, and generates recommendations.
